market_read: Week 9 snapshot: 11 verified rows (0 new, 11 persisting), 2 gone, 0 indicative. Two delistings this week: Pagsanjan Barangay I (13,000 sqm, PHP 700/sqm) and Liliw Pag-Asa (4,684 sqm, PHP 1,200/sqm) — individual Dot Property URLs now return 404; whether these represent sales or listing expirations is unconfirmed. If Barangay I sold at PHP 700/sqm, it is the most recent Pagsanjan-core clearance signal and lower than the prior fastest-sale recommendation of PHP 1,000/sqm, suggesting real demand floor may be softer than indicated by asking prices. Verified range PHP 269–2,800/sqm; dataset median PHP 2,000/sqm (6th of 11 rows). Pagsanjan-core holds 4 rows (Lambac PHP 850/sqm, Pinagsanjan PHP 1,100/sqm, Sabang PHP 1,500/sqm, Maulawin PHP 2,000/sqm); Pagsanjan-core median PHP 1,300/sqm. Ring municipalities median PHP 2,000/sqm. All 11 remaining rows carry unchanged asking prices for the second straight week — no price reductions, consistent aging inventory. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, recommended asking range PHP 1,400–1,800/sqm; fastest-sale price PHP 900–1,000/sqm; if the Barangay I delisting is a confirmed sale, the realistic floor may be PHP 700–800/sqm.
